title: Soniee
description: Soniee was a gifted student at the Royal Academy of Government on Mandalore, being trained as one of the future leaders of the planet. There, she and her fellow students stumbled onto a plot of corruption they would investigate further. Using her technical savvy, Soniee helped her fellow students—including the Duchess Satine's nephew Korkie Kryze—get into secret warehouses that revealed a robust and illegal black market operation on Mandalore. The clues led them to discover it was run by Prime Minister Almec himself.
